description: Removes one public name (a DNS entry), by its id from list_dns_entries or by the name itself. The name stops serving at once, and anything reached through it (a site, an API, an OAuth callback) stops working with it. When the name belongs to one of your instances or deployments, that instance's own list of its names is updated too, the way the console's DNS view does it; the instance, its app and its data are untouched. The first call removes nothing: it shows the entry for the user to approve; call again with confirm:true only after their yes. Use it to clear the names a release_domain refusal (DOMAIN_IN_USE) lists. redu's own platform names cannot be removed.

confirm.description: Set true ONLY after the user has explicitly approved removing this name (see the confirmation the first call returns). Do NOT set it yourself.

id.description: The entry's id: `id` in list_dns_entries, or in the names a DOMAIN_IN_USE refusal of release_domain lists.

name.description: Or a public name the entry serves (e.g. shop.example.com), when exactly one entry has it.

name: delete_dns_entry
title: Remove a public name (needs approval)
